reuse.why: Introduces one isHoliday helper in shared/schedules.ts and routes every existing holiday membership check (getNextDate, getScheduleDate, getDatesInRange) through it.

duplication.why: Replaces three inline holidays.includes checks with one definition; the surrounding 'isWeekend || holiday' non-working-day predicate is still spelled out at three sites, as it was before, instead of reusing getScheduleDate's local isNonWorkingDay.

placement.why: The helper lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduleDate and getNextDate, and the server handler imports it from there.

scope.why: Only the holiday matching and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Holiday matching now has a single definition, so further holiday formats are one edit; exporting the full non-working-day predicate would have been tidier.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is introduced; the copies of the membership check are removed.
